g.text: Raw predicted log HR(z); separate treatment × score Cox evaluation models
Pointwise robust 95% CIs. JUPITER: ten-fold OOF, stratified by fold. ESCORT: frozen external, no fold strata.
OS evaluates the PFS-derived score; the interaction HR is per one raw score unit.
